1313 Sparrow Trail
Copperas Cove, TX 76522
$296,940, 3 bed, 2.00 bath, 2,121 SF, MLS# 609905

Welcome home to this lovely well maintained home in the desirable Golf Course community of Turkey Creek Estates! This 3 bedroom and 2 bath home boasts 2121 sq.ft. of living space on .31 acres. Friends and family entertaining has been made easier in this home with two dining areas, a spacious family room with a fireplace, a huge outdoor deck, and a backyard with a privacy fence. The Master retreat is huge with an ensuite bath. Relax in the garden tub after a rough day, or shower in the separate shower. Two large walk-in closets in the Master suite help to keep your personal items organized. 
The two minor bedrooms are a good size as well. The owners just installed beautiful laminate wood flooring in the living areas, and new carpet in the bedrooms.  Approximate measurements are listed. Call today to see this beautiful property!

2 full bath
